FRAME 4 — THE UNMASKING. The Aurora Night Sleeper set, animated-cel register. Master 1640x2048, 4:5 portrait.

SCENE — from the engine end of the open observation deck at standing height, dawn ahead. OBSERVATION DECK: open brass-railed deck at the train's tail, boards underfoot. RAIL: the brass stern rail the gang stands along. LAGOON: still dawn water on both sides, the train's wake trailing. VENICE SKYLINE: far ahead, domes and a campanile in silhouette, shapes only. ENGINE END: the camera end, deck lamps still lit.

STAGING — Void: stands revealed at his full height in the middle of the collapsed greatcoat, black body fully visible above the heap, perfectly still, hose arms at his sides, round head unbowed — standing perfectly still and silent [OBSERVATION DECK — deck-centre, revealed at his full height; gaze on the lagoon, past everyone]

STAGING — the Grey Passenger: lies collapsed where it stands revealed — the greatcoat heaped, the stilt frame snapped inside it, an empty costume [OBSERVATION DECK — collapsed heap on the boards; gaze on the costume's empty interior of cloth]

STAGING — Wyatt, in the black cardigan, white t-shirt and black cargo trousers; never the deep-red wrap dress; never the plain black t-shirt and black jeans: holds the grey peaked cap HIGH in his raised right hand for all to see, his left arm hanging at his side, his own black mask still on his face — the masked man holding the fake's hat [OBSERVATION DECK — frame-left of Void; gaze on the culprit]

STAGING — Lucy, in the plain black t-shirt and black jeans; never the black cardigan, white t-shirt and black cargo trousers; never the deep-red wrap dress: holds the real diamond up in both hands at shoulder height, raised like a trophy, lagoon dawn firing blue-white through the stone, her face turned up toward it with a small satisfied smile — the detective with the prize [OBSERVATION DECK — in the foreground, a full step closer to the camera than anyone; gaze on the diamond]

STAGING — Akane, in the deep-red wrap dress; never the black cardigan, white t-shirt and black cargo trousers; never the plain black t-shirt and black jeans: stands slightly bent at the waist, presenting Cyndi with an enormous bare marrow bone, unwrapped: the bone is in Cyndi's mouth between her front paws, and Akane's left hand steadies it as she presents it — the green-dial Rolex on that wrist catching the dawn — her other hand resting at her hip, an expression of pure deadpan on her face [OBSERVATION DECK — deck-right, half a step behind Lucy's line; gaze on Cyndi]

STAGING — Cyndi: sits up tall in a begging pose, front paws holding the enormous bone, ears up, eyes fixed on it — the happiest person on the train [OBSERVATION DECK — in front of Akane, up on her hind legs; gaze on the bone]

PROP — real diamond: the real Aurora Diamond, a clear brilliant-cut gem the size of a pigeon's egg, held up in Lucy's fingers by its edges [owner: Lucy; anchor: OBSERVATION DECK]

PROP — peaked cap: the Grey Passenger's tall grey peaked cap with a cracked patent visor [owner: Wyatt; anchor: OBSERVATION DECK]

PROP — marrow bone: an enormous bare marrow bone, unwrapped and bare [owner: Cyndi; anchor: OBSERVATION DECK]

MOMENT — The reveal at dawn, caught a breath after the capture — every gaze is on the cap, the culprit, the stone, or each other. The conductor applauds alone at the deck's engine-end edge, the only audience the gang needs.

ENVIRONMENT INVENTORY: open deck boards; the brass stern rail; the train's wake creasing the still lagoon; the Venice, Italy skyline ahead in soft silhouette — St Mark's campanile, domes and moored gondolas on lagoon water, unmistakably Venice; deck lamps still burning warm; a dropped ticket lying face-down showing only blank paper.

LIGHTING: rose-gold dawn key from dead ahead behind the skyline, rimming the group; warm deck lamps low fill; soft long shadows up the boards.

COLOUR: full, rich, celebratory colour everywhere in the generation — rose dawn, gold lamps, blue lagoon.

NEGATIVES: the skyline, the ticket and the stone carry blank surfaces; a calm aftermath: everyone whole, free and unhurt, with clean costumes and undamaged props; Void stands upright, free and whole; Akane's hands stay busy in her lap or at her sides; the far shore is Venice, Italy: lagoon, domes, campanile and gondolas; Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck.

VOID (verbatim block): Void is a 1930s rubberhose cartoon character rendered as a slim humanoid silhouette in flat, pure matte black, with a perfectly round ball head — a clean black circle from every angle — whose diameter is one fifth of its total height. Its head carries one smooth unbroken black surface: a blank face, plain and unornamented, and that same flat matte black continues over its whole body as a single textureless surface. Its neck is short and narrow. Its arms and legs are jointless rubber hoses of NORMAL human length that hang in smooth continuous curves, all elbowless and kneeless, curving rather than angling; its hands reach mid-thigh and end in simple black four-fingered hose hands, with large rounded bulbous black rubberhose shoe-feet below. Void stands upright and motionless, still and unbending — a rubberhose character that keeps perfectly still; its stillness is its threat.

THE GREY PASSENGER (verbatim block): The Grey Passenger is a gaunt figure about 225cm tall: a floor-length greatcoat of layered ash-grey railway wool with a high collar, brass buttons dull with age, and a long ticket-punch chain at the belt; a smooth blank oval face of matte light grey, featureless except two deep hollow black oval eyes and a small dark open oval mouth — plainly a theatrical costume mask; a tall grey peaked cap with a cracked patent visor; very long draped sleeves that completely hide the hands; one hand always raised carrying a dim green-shaded inspector's lantern; a faint haze of coal dust around its hem. It is a person in a railway costume: a solid figure standing on its own feet, the greatcoat dense opaque wool with its hem resting on the ground, dressed for a harmless theatrical fright. IN THIS FRAME ONLY: the costume is off its wearer — the greatcoat lies collapsed in a heap on the deck where he stands revealed inside it, and the peaked cap is the separate grey shape Wyatt holds high.

WYATT (verbatim block): Wyatt is an adult man in flat painterly cel animation, drawn EXACTLY as in his cel reference sheet — the same man. He is 153cm tall and exactly 5 heads in proportion: his head, hair and mask together are one fifth of his height, with a grown man's construction throughout and legs about half his height. His hair is voluminous black curls, medium length. On his neck sit two portrait tattoos facing inward toward the throat: a crowned bearded KING on his left side, and a crowned QUEEN — a woman — on his right.

WYATT'S MASK (verbatim, mandatory): The mask is a tall smooth shield of matte black covering his whole face in one piece, from the hairline above his brow down past his jaw and chin, edge to edge across both cheeks. Its surface is plain matte black throughout. It carries two round holes, one at each eye, and those two holes are its only openings: each one opens onto flat empty blackness. The mask reads as a single unbroken black form from forehead to chin, with both round eye holes always present and open.

WYATT'S OUTFIT — wyatt.city: a black knit button cardigan (5 buttons, patch pockets) worn open over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt; black cargo pants with side flap pockets; black Adidas Samba sneakers with white side stripes, gum-brown soles and a small blue heel tab.

LUCY (verbatim block): Lucy is a Puerto Rican woman with a wide, slightly flattened oval face, a defined angular jawline softer at the cheeks, a light dusting of freckles across her nose and cheeks, and skin in a light warm tan. Her eyes are large vertical ovals with green irises and a heavy lower lash line: the lid line sweeps smoothly from inner to outer corner, and each iris fills its opening with clear green. She is 5 feet 4 inches tall with a very slim, willowy build — narrow shoulders and ribcage, a small waist, slim hips, thin arms and long legs (inseam about 48% of her height, natural waist at about 60%) — and a full, generous F bust. Her hair is long loose waves to mid-back, centre-parted, black with graphic sculptural clumps. Everything she wears is black and white; coral is her design signature — it lives in her work as ink and paper, while her skin and face stay clean, bare and untouched.

LUCY'S OUTFIT — lucy.tee_jeans: a plain black t-shirt tucked in at the waist, black jeans cuffed at the ankle, white socks, plain black leather loafers, her two gold hoop earrings.

AKANE (verbatim block): Akane is a petite Japanese woman, 153cm tall and 5 heads in proportion, with pale porcelain skin, blue eyes, and long black hair worn mostly straight with loose waves at the ends and a full straight fringe across her forehead. Her legs are natural in length and proportion, in keeping with her five-head build. She carries herself with the manner of a temptress — a heavy-lidded, knowing gaze, languid and magnetic, self-assured, arms folded or one hand on her hip, her hands busy and active at her hip or her sides. She is self-contained and absorbed in her own action, with a lively, expressive face. She is rendered in a painterly cel style, more softly modelled than flat cel animation.

AKANE'S OUTFIT — akane.tailored_dress: a deep-red matte wrap dress with a shirt collar, a belted waist, three-quarter sleeves and a knee-to-midi skirt, in matte crepe, sheer black tights, black loafers with tan fur trim and a gold horsebit, a gold Cartier Love bangle on her right wrist and a gold Rolex watch with a deep green dial on her left wrist.

CYNDI (verbatim block): Cyndi is a lean, athletic medium-sized mixed-breed dog with a short uniform golden-tan coat, a long muzzle that is BLACK with a little grey around the mouth, large upright pointed ears with dark backs, dark brown eyes, a small white patch on her chest and white tips on her paws, and a straight medium-length tail carried low with a dark tip. Her build is that of a grown athletic mixed breed with normal leg length for her size: a long straight tail, a lean foxy muzzle and a short smooth coat, exactly the adult dog shown in her attached reference images.

SCALE: Void is 165cm — the tallest in this frame; Lucy (163cm), Wyatt (153cm), Akane (153cm), Cyndi (58cm).
Wyatt and Akane stand at exactly the same height (153cm).

The black cardigan, white t-shirt and black cargo trousers appears exactly once in this frame, on Wyatt.

The plain black t-shirt and black jeans appears exactly once in this frame, on Lucy.

The deep-red wrap dress appears exactly once in this frame, on Akane.

RENDER GRADE — ANIMATED (verbatim in every frame): Flat painterly cel animation — bold clean ink outlines, flat colour fills with soft cel shading, the look of a hand-drawn animated feature film: a classic cartoon mystery adventure retold as an animated film still. Cinematic composition, dramatic motivated lighting rendered in cel tones. 4:5 portrait composition. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no captions, no logos and no watermark anywhere in the image.
